newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Piper Jaffray starts retailers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Piper Jaffray starts retailers.

text.p: Piper Jaffray said it initiated coverage of Consolidated Stores Corp and 99 Cent Only Stores with strong buy ratings.
-- said started Mazel Stores Inc as a buy.

-- said Consolidates Stores is a "must own" company in the "extreme value retailing universe"... said the company has "compelling remaining opportunity for growth"...set a 12-month price target of $53 a share.
-- said 99 Cent Stores has limited geographic penetration, which "implies tremendous opportunity for growth"...set a 12-month price target of $36 a share.
-- said is encouraged by Maxel's outlook and strong management team...set a 12-month price target of $20.
